create_solver_context: create a solver context from a MuJoCo model and data for constraint solving iterations
run_solve: run the conjugate gradient solver to find forces that satisfy constraints on a MuJoCo model
update_constraint: update constraint force and cost given the latest solver iteration for elliptic or pyramidal cones
update_gradient: update gradient and preconditioned gradient for CG or Newton solver types
perform_linesearch: perform a zoom linesearch to find optimal search step size for constraint optimization
